components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Makes the Valet Pike, the only weapon that hurts the Spirit of the Beast. A full-moon night only, in a medium circle, with iron, wolfsbane, mountain ash dust and sire's blood.
Only a witch type can work it. The blood must come from a hunter, an advanced vampire or werewolf, an Alpha, or an Original, hybrid or tribrid: a plain player's is not enough.
A refusal always reads the same and still spends everything, so it cannot be used to find out what somebody is.
